verdict.rationale: Secureframe's first-party framework pages cover HIPAA (policy setup, employee/vendor/asset management), GDPR (cloud configuration checks), and PCI DSS (end-to-end certification support), alongside SOC 2 and ISO 27001. The compliance-platform and llms.txt pages extend coverage to CMMC and NIST 800-171, which supports the single-platform multi-framework claim. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of cross-framework control mapping or evidence reuse within one workspace, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the non-SOC 2 frameworks.
